steps.en: Install a build with the delegates you need
steps.zh: 装一个带齐所需委托库的版本
steps.code: brew install imagemagick · winget install ImageMagick.Q16-HDRI

steps.en: Pick a security policy that matches how far you trust the input
steps.zh: 按输入可信程度选一份安全策略

steps.en: Write one command: inputs, operators in order, output
steps.zh: 写一条命令：输入、按顺序的操作、输出

steps.en: Sniffs each file's format and decodes it, natively or via a delegate
steps.zh: 识别每个文件的格式并解码，自己解或交给委托库

component.zh: 编解码模块 + 委托库

steps.en: Checks the policy, then applies the operators in order on the pixel cache
steps.zh: 先查策略，再在像素缓存上按顺序执行操作

steps.en: Encodes to the format named by the output extension
steps.zh: 按输出文件扩展名编码成目标格式

value.en: One shell line converts, resizes or composites a whole folder across 200+ formats, with no code to write
value.zh: 一行命令就能把整个文件夹在 200 多种格式间转换、缩放或合成，不用写代码

sources: https://imagemagick.org/download/ (brew install imagemagick, winget install ImageMagick.Q16-HDRI)
https://imagemagick.org/security-policy/ (policy.xml, open by default, open/limited/secure/websafe policies)
https://imagemagick.org/command-line-processing/ (command structure: input, operators, output; explicit formats)
https://imagemagick.org/formats/ (delegate libraries and programs: Ghostscript, libheif, ffmpeg)
